artists.source_line: Kizz-N Organisation has the right to update the Festival.

features.rationale: The listed venue features state three big rooms, meaning more than one dance room.
The venue section lists 35 hours of workshops as part of the festival.
The venue section lists taxi teams among the festival's features.
Masterclasses are listed as a ticket option, booked extra.
The Saturday program includes a social in the afternoon and early evening.
A main booking hotel is recommended, with a special discount code, without the accommodation being part of the pass.
A transfer section lists the airport, main station and bus station with travel times from the venue.
